children: Russia's annual inflation rate rose to 6.3% in August 2026, its highest level since November of 2025, up from 6% in the previous month and matching markets expectations.
Food inflation rose to 5% from 4.4% while non-food cost growth also inched higher to 6.5% from 6.4%.
Motor gasoline inflation slowed to 24.6% from 25.9%, although remaining elevated as Ukrainian attacks on Russian energy infrastructure hampered its refining capacity.
In turn, inflation for passanger transports rose further to 10.7% from 9.1% in the prior month, while services inflation edged up to 7.9% from 7.8%.
Core inflation also rose to 5.4% from 5.2%, reaching its highest level in seven months.
Meanwhile, inflation for utilities remained largely unchanged at 1.6%.
Compared to the previous month, consumer prices fell 0.1%, reversing a 0.5% rise in the prior month.

title: Russia Inflation Rate Rises as Expected
